run_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI to convert a fine-tune checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint
run_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_with_ya: run the CLI to convert a fine-tune checkpoint and its YAML config to release format
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_function: convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint by merging backbone and heads config from the starting checkpoint
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_data_only: convert a data-only fine-tuned checkpoint by copying backbone and heads from the starting checkpoint
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_yaml_only: convert a fine-tune YAML config by removing finetune_config and merging backbone from the starting checkpoint
